answer: Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sonnet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
